subject.title: fix(tui): handle live session message updates

question: Should maintainers require an inspectable redacted live artifact for the Gateway-to-running-TUI path before merge, or explicitly accept the described source-blind live run as a proof override?
rationale: The code review found no blocking patch defect, but the PR is external and the only live behavior evidence is prose plus run IDs, not an artifact that reviewers can inspect.

options.title: Require Inspectable Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, a recording, or a linked artifact showing another Gateway client appending a marker that appears in an already-running TUI before merge.

options.title: Accept Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly treat the described source-blind live run and native artifacts as sufficient, but that should be recorded as the proof decision before landing.

recommendation.title: Require Inspectable Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, a recording, or a linked artifact showing another Gateway client appending a marker that appears in an already-running TUI before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned, rewrote the current head, and posted the proof context that maintainers would need to accept or ask to replace.
